candidate.answerReason: There are three births and one death per day, giving a yearly net increase of 730 people, or 732 in a leap year. Both round to 700.

methods.label: Find the net increase per day
methods.explanation:
There are \(24\div8=3\) births each day. Subtracting the one death gives a net increase of \(3-1=2\) people per day. Over a \(365\)-day year, the increase is
\[
2\times365=730.
\]
This rounds to \(\boxed{700}\) to the nearest hundred, choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\). A leap year gives \(2\times366=732\), which rounds to the same answer.
methods.levelReason: Uses daily rates, whole-number arithmetic, and rounding to the nearest hundred, appropriate for AMC 8.
